title: DHH says Gemini 4 Neon halved Omarchy’s boot time
summary: DHH credits one model with cutting boot time in half, along with install optimizations.

topics.angle: The strongest current claim for building an OS with agents.
Speed headed for a coming release.
Who is credited, in the post and in the commits.

claims.text: Boot time was cut in half.
The post had 10,448 likes and about 534,000 views when read.
DHH credits Gemini 4 Neon with the optimizations behind the sub-five-second install.
Of three install changes we read, none credits Gemini 4 Neon and one credits Claude Fable 5.2. A commit need not name every tool used.

to_find: Before and after times on one machine
would_change: A before-and-after measurement that is not close to half.
